description:
With the success of our Half Pint Model, we often get asked – what happens when my child grows out of the Half Pint but is not yet big enough to fit an adult trike.

With that in mind we have introduced the ¾ Pint. The ¾ Pint is our Youth Sized trike that should fit ages approximately 8-14.

The 3/4 Pint is an Aluminum Powder Coated Lightweight Trike that is a scaled down version or our adult Trikes

Some features include 18” Wheels, Scaled down brake levers, Disc Brakes, adjustable angle Aluminum Seat with Pad, adjustable boom, a Shimano Nexus 3 Speed Internal Hub, and Ackerman Compensated Steering!

The 3/4 Pint is also extremely lightweight at 22.5 LBS!

The ¾ Pint is available in Green and Blue. It Retails for $949.00 plus $125 shipping in the US. The 3/4 Pint is Fully Assembled
